title: A Unified Framework for Intelligent Cyber Attack Detection and Alert Correlation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26824v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A Security Operations Center (SOC) plays a critical role in detecting, correlating, and responding to modern cyber threats. However, SOCs continue to face challenges related to alert overload, fragmented detection capabilities, and limited collaboration between analysts and automated systems. These issues often result in delayed incident response, analyst fatigue, and an increased risk of overlooking sophisticated, multi-stage attacks that unfold gradually across different layers of the network. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a unified framework for network traffic classification and alert correlation through the use of signature rules, machine learning, and sequential pattern mining algorithms. The solution was evaluated in a controlled testbed environment emulating realistic, multi-stage attack scenarios, including malware exploitation, lateral movement, reconnaissance, and data exfiltration. translated_title: 智能网络攻击检测与告警关联的统一框架
translated_abstract: 安全运营中心（SOC）在现代网络威胁的检测、关联和响应中发挥着关键作用。然而，SOC 仍持续面临告警过载、检测能力碎片化以及分析师与自动化系统之间协作有限等挑战。这些问题常常导致事件响应延迟、分析师疲劳，并增加了忽视那些在网络不同层面逐步展开的复杂多阶段攻击的风险。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一个通过综合运用签名规则、机器学习和序列模式挖掘算法来实现网络流量分类与告警关联的统一框架。该解决方案在一个模拟真实多阶段攻击场景的可控测试环境中进行了评估，攻击场景包括恶意软件利用、横向移动、侦察和数据渗出等。所获得的结果表……
tldr: 本文提出一个融合签名规则、机器学习和序列模式挖掘算法的统一框架，用于网络流量分类与告警关联，以缓解安全运营中心（SOC）的告警过载问题并有效检测多阶段网络攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework combining signature rules, machine learning, and sequential pattern mining for network traffic classification and alert correlation, aiming to alleviate alert overload in SOCs and effectively detect multi-stage cyber attacks.
